title: Project Serpo exchange program

tellings.quote: And like Serpo is about an alien exchange program essentially where um apparently we sent we after Roswell the crash happened the recovered EBE right extraterrestrial biological entity

plain: After the 1947 crash at Roswell, New Mexico, the United States is said to have recovered a living alien, an "EBE" or extraterrestrial biological entity, and then to have taken part in an exchange programme in which Americans were sent to the alien's home planet, called Serpo. An unnamed researcher who appears on the show describes this from the Project Serpo papers, documents tied to the physicist Hal Puthoff, the former Air Force intelligence agent Richard Doty and the Defense Intelligence Agency, the Pentagon's military spy service. If true, it would mean humans have already visited another world.
